description: Minimal capability for host-owned analysis windows. These windows render declarative plugin reports or built-in analysis snapshots through trusted app components and hold NO plugin code. They receive window geometry, event listening and narrow native panel forwarders; arbitrary event emission is denied so panel actions cannot spoof another window's identity. They hold no filesystem, dialog, clipboard or generic command-routing permission. Plugin code still executes in a CSP-restricted worker with no IPC.
